prompt: my emails are going to spam, how many new domains should I buy

assertions.name: audits-first
assertions.check: Audits existing auth (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), reputation and placement BEFORE recommending a purchase

assertions.name: refuses-blind-purchase
assertions.check: Refuses to give a domain count as the primary answer

assertions.name: explains-order
assertions.check: Explains that buying domains fixes only one of several failure modes
